_about: The Boots slot is the movement engine (SPEC.md › Boots and movement modes). `bases` are the rollable boots: mode decides whether you roll, spin or draw; `die` is the movement die; `stop` mirrors the balance rule (movement.halfStopDice / fullWalkDice decide at runtime): any = stop whenever, half = only after half the roll, never = walk it all unless blocked. `wheel.segments` is the movement wheel in order; a segment with `stepsKey` reads its step count from balance.json › movement. `colourDeck` describes the per-run card deck: one card per secret colour times `perColour`, plus `movement.colourDoubles` doubles (one per colour). `uniques` and `affixes` are the ids handlers/movement.js honours on a worn boots item (`item.unique`, `item.affixes[].id` with kind 'movement').

bases.name: Cobbler's Slippers
bases.text: Roll a d4. Stop whenever you like.

bases.name: Loaded Boots
bases.text: Roll a d6. Stop whenever you like.

bases.name: Knucklebone Greaves
bases.text: Roll a d8. You may stop once half the roll is walked.

bases.name: Decahedron Striders
bases.text: Roll a d10. You may stop once half the roll is walked.

bases.name: Dodeca Sabatons
bases.text: Roll a d12 and walk every step of it.

bases.name: Fateful Treads
bases.text: Roll a d20 and walk every step of it.

bases.name: Croupier's Heels
bases.text: Spin the movement wheel: 1 to 6, Sprint, Stumble, Teleport, Swap.

bases.name: Breaking-Wheel Boots
bases.text: Spin the movement wheel. The wheel is a breaking wheel.

bases.name: Dyer's Boots
bases.text: Draw a colour and go to the nearest hex of that colour in range.

bases.name: Painted Soles
bases.text: Draw a colour and go to the nearest hex of that colour in range.

choosemode.name: Choose your mode
choosemode.text: Pick dice, wheel or card at the start of every move (payload.mode).

movetwice.name: Move twice
movetwice.text: After your tile resolves you may roll a second move this turn.

skates.name: Skates of the Sixth
skates.text: Roll 2d6, cannot stop early, and slide one extra hex in your last direction.

octane.name: Octane Treads
octane.text: The movement wheel loses Stumble and gains two Boost segments; ending next to a player bumps them 1 hex.

twoDice.text: Two dice one size down instead of one

keepStop.text: Keep the stop-early right on a big die

homeBonus.text: +1 step in the region these boots came from

extraSprint.text: A second Sprint on the wheel

peekTop.text: See the top card of the colour deck

moreDoubles.text: Twice the doubles in the deck
